'''Lucyna Mirosława Falkowska''' (1951 – 7 April 2021) was a Polish scientist and [[Oceanography|oceanographer]]. She  specialized in [[atmospheric chemistry]], chemical oceanography and protection of the marine environment. Falkowska worked on the Faculty of Oceanography and Geography of [[University of Gdańsk]].<ref>[https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=33695&_k=3ntdsf prof. dr hab. Lucyna Mirosława Falkowska (nie żyje)]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://opac.ciniba.edu.pl/192504177251/falkowskalucyna/chemiaatmosfery|title=Falkowska, Lucyna - Chemia atmosfery / Lucyna Falkowska, Krzysztof Korzeniewski., 83-7017-618-6, Biblioteki UŚ i UE Katowice, PROLIB OPAC WWW|date=April 10, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160410142007/http://opac.ciniba.edu.pl/192504177251/falkowskalucyna/chemiaatmosfery|archive-date=2016-04-10}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.mercuryconvention.org/News/fromtheConvention/TributetoLucynaFalkowska/tabid/8799/language/en-US/Default.aspx|title=Tribute to Lucyna Falkowska|website=www.mercuryconvention.org}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ilmexhibitions.com/news/mercury/Professor+Lucyna+Falkowska++-++In+Memory/943/|title=Professor Lucyna Falkowska - In Memory|website=www.ilmexhibitions.com}}</ref><ref name=auto>{{Cite web|url=https://ug.edu.pl/news/pl/1069/pozegnanie-prof-dr-hab-lucyna-falkowska|title=Pożegnanie - prof. dr hab. ==Education==
Falkowska obtained her doctorate in 1986 with a thesis on the inflow of [[nitrogen]] and [[phosphorus]] compounds from the atmosphere to the [[Baltic Sea]] (based on studies of the Southern Baltic Sea 1981–1985).<ref name=":0" />

On 29 September 1997 Falkowska was awarded a postdoctoral degree in oceanology at the Department of Biology, Geography and Oceanology, University of Gdańsk, on the basis of her thesis "Sea surface microvegetation: properties and processes".<ref name=":1" /> The habilitation process began on 1 January 1996.

==Career==
Falkowska directed several research projects in 2001. On 8 June 2006, Falkowska was awarded the title of Professor of Earth Sciences by President [[Lech Kaczyński]].<ref name="auto" /><ref name=":1" />

Falkowska was full professor and head of the Laboratory of Sea and Atmospheric Chemistry at the Institute of Oceanography, Faculty of Oceanography and Geography, University of Gdańsk. She was a specialist member of the Committee for Marine Research, Division III of the Natural Sciences and Earth Sciences of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":1" />

From 1999 to 2011 Falkowska was a supervisor of eleven PhD theses, a reviewer of two habilitation theses and three PhD theses.<ref name=":1" />

==Honours and awards==
In 1999, she was awarded the [[Golden Cross of Merit]]. She also received the Medal of the National Education Commission and many awards from the Rector of the University of Gdańsk. She was a member of the [[Gdańsk Scientific Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pożegnanie - prof. dr hab. Lucyna Falkowska {{!}} Aktualności - Uniwersytet Gdański|url=https://ug.edu.pl/news/pl/1069/pozegnanie-prof-dr-hab-lucyna-falkowska|access-date=2021-04-19|website=ug.edu.pl}}</ref>

==Death==
Falkowska died on 7 April 2021.<ref name=auto />
